name: Pick-Up
brief: Your trailer's waiting in the yard. Back the tractor under it, couple up, then reverse it onto Bay 3.

tutorial.text: Your trailer's parked behind you. Reverse the tractor slowly under it – the fifth wheel has to meet the kingpin (the orange cross on the trailer). Hold {reverse}.
Nearly under. Keep it straight and slow – under 1.5 mph. The guide shows the distance to the kingpin and how far off centre you are.
Coupled! Air lines on, legs up. Now reverse the trailer onto Bay 3 – watch the trailer, not the cab.
Trailer drifting off line? Steer towards the side it's drifting to, then centre the wheel as it comes back.
Nearly there. Ease off and touch the buffers at walking pace – under 2 mph.
All three checks are green. Stop and press {handbrake} to put the handbrake on.
Contact! Each bump adds 5 seconds. Anything at 2.5 mph or more and it's game over.
